title: Conveyancing Assistant
description:
Conveyancing Assistant

Norwich

£26,000-£32,000

Full-time Permanent

Are you looking to develop your career within residential conveyancing and specialise in post-completion matters within an established and respected law firm?

We are working with a well-respected firm who are seeking a Conveyancing Assistant to join their busy and successful Residential Property team. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone with previous conveyancing experience who enjoys working with documentation, ensuring accuracy and helping transactions reach their final stages efficiently.

The successful candidate will play a key role in supporting the post-completion process, ensuring all necessary registrations, submissions and administrative tasks are completed accurately and within the required timescales.

The role will involve:
- Providing comprehensive administrative and legal support throughout the residential conveyancing process, from instruction through to post-completion.
- Assisting with the preparation and progression of conveyancing transactions, ensuring all relevant documentation is accurately prepared and processed.
- Reviewing title documentation, property searches and legal paperwork, identifying any discrepancies or outstanding requirements.
- Preparing and submitting applications to HM Land Registry, including dealing with requisitions and resolving any issues that arise.
- Completing and submitting SDLT returns and arranging payment where required.
- Assisting with exchange and completion arrangements, ensuring all necessary documentation and requirements are in place

The ideal candidate will have:
- Previous experience within residential conveyancing, ideally in a post-completion-focused role
- A good understanding of the post-completion process, including Land Registry applications
- Experience preparing SDLT returns and dealing with Land Registry requisitions would be advantageous
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage deadlines
- Excellent attention to detail and a methodical approach to work
- Confident communication skills and the ability to work effectively within a team
- Experience using a legal case management system would be beneficial

What's on Offer
- Opportunity to join a respected and established law firm
- Supportive and collaborative working environment
- Ongoing training and career development opportunities
- The opportunity to develop specialist post-completion expertise
- Long-term progression opportunities within the legal profession

Why Apply?

This role is ideal for a Conveyancing Assistant or Post-Completion Assistant looking to build on their existing experience within a reputable Residential Property team. You'll play an important role in ensuring transactions are finalised accurately and efficiently, while developing your expertise in Land Registry applications, SDLT and post-completion procedures.

title: Conveyancing Assistant
description:
Conveyancing Assistant

Salary: Competitive, dependent on experience
Location: Norwich, Norfolk

SJC Legal is currently working with a well-established and highly regarded law firm looking to recruit an experienced Conveyancing Assistant to join its Residential Property team in Norwich.

This is an excellent opportunity for a Legal Assistant or Paralegal with residential conveyancing experience who is looking to join a reputable firm and provide valuable support to experienced Conveyancers within a busy property department.

The Benefits
- Competitive salary depending on experience
- Opportunity to join an established Residential Property team
- Work alongside experienced Conveyancers and Solicitors
- Exposure to a varied residential conveyancing caseload
- Opportunity to further develop your conveyancing knowledge and experience

The Role
- Provide day-to-day support to Residential Conveyancing Fee Earners
- Assist with Freehold and Leasehold Sales and Purchases
- Support transactions from initial instruction through to completion and post-completion
- Prepare conveyancing documentation and correspondence
- Order property searches and assist with enquiries
- Liaise with clients, estate agents, mortgage brokers and other solicitors
- Assist with exchange and completion processes
- Maintain accurate records using the firm's Case Management system
- Ensure matters progress efficiently while delivering excellent client care

The Candidate
- Have previous experience within Residential Conveyancing
- Be an experienced Conveyancing Assistant, Legal Assistant or Property Paralegal
- Have a good understanding of the residential conveyancing process
- Be confident communicating with clients and other professionals
- Have strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail
- Be comfortable managing competing priorities and deadlines
- Be proactive, reliable and able to work effectively as part of a team

How to Apply
For a confidential discussion regarding this opportunity, or to discuss other conveyancing positions currently available across Norfolk, please contact Alex Wilcock, Legal Recruitment Consultant at SJC Legal.

title: Conveyancing Assistant

Apply today to find out more!

title: paralegal
description:
Job Title: Paralegal

About the Role

We are seeking a motivated, organised and detail-oriented Paralegal to join a legal team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with previous legal experience who is looking to develop their skills and progress their career within a professional legal environment.

The successful candidate will provide legal and administrative support to solicitors and fee earners, assisting with case management, legal documentation, client communication and the day-to-day running of legal matters.

Key Responsibilities
- Assisting solicitors and fee earners with the management and progression of legal cases.
- Preparing, drafting and reviewing legal documents and correspondence.
- Conducting legal research and summarising findings where required.
- Maintaining accurate and up-to-date client files and case management records.
- Liaising with clients, courts, counsel, third parties and other relevant organisations.
- Preparing bundles, schedules and supporting documentation.
- Monitoring deadlines and ensuring documents are completed and submitted on time.
- Supporting case preparation and ensuring compliance with relevant procedures.
- Providing general administrative support to the legal team.
- Maintaining confidentiality and delivering a professional standard of client care.

Requirements
- Previous experience working within a legal environment is desirable, with experience requirements depending on the level of the role.
- A law degree, LPC, SQE-related qualification or relevant legal experience would be advantageous.
- Good written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail.
- The ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
- A professional and client-focused approach.
- The ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Good IT skills and familiarity with legal case management systems would be beneficial.

The Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate will be proactive, reliable and enthusiastic about developing their legal career. They will have a strong work ethic, a willingness to learn and the ability to support a busy legal team effectively.

How to Apply

If you have the relevant skills and experience and are interested in developing your career within the legal sector, we would welcome your application.

title: Private Client Paralegal - King's Lynn - &;25,000-30,000
description:
An established Norfolk law firm is looking to add a Private Client Paralegal to its team in King's Lynn.

This is a good opportunity to join an established department where you'll be working alongside experienced fee earners and gaining exposure to a varied range of Private Client matters. The firm is looking for someone with some existing experience who wants to build on that, develop their knowledge and become an important part of the team.

You'll be involved in a broad range of work, including:
- Assisting with Wills, Lasting Powers of Attorney and estate administration.
- Helping to prepare estate accounts and deal with inheritance tax matters.
- Drafting correspondence and legal documents.
- Liaising directly with clients and helping to keep matters moving.
- Managing files, carrying out AML checks and providing support to fee earners.

You'll have the opportunity to develop your experience across the department. It's a role that offers a good platform for someone looking to build a long-term career in Private Client.

Previous Private Client experience is important, but the firm is open to someone who is keen to learn, take on more responsibility and continue progressing.

If you're based in or around King's Lynn and are considering your next move in Private Client, I'd be happy to have a confidential chat.
